subject: raindrops on glass with blurred camellia leaves

visible_description: 玻璃下半部的雨珠映着模糊山茶叶，浅灰蓝光让画面清新。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Photograph clear raindrops gathered on the lower half of a window, with blurred camellia leaves behind the glass. Keep the largest droplets sharp enough to hold tiny green reflections, while the surrounding surface stays softly luminous. Use cool overcast light and a gentle gray-blue palette. Avoid a dense curtain of rain, emphasizing freshness and a quiet indoor-outdoor boundary. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
